record.oneLiner: Pinterest provides a broad REST API for managing pins, boards, and ads, but requires developer application review and approval before producing usable production credentials.
record.verdictReason: Pinterest offers a comprehensive REST API covering content, ads, and catalogs using OAuth 2.0 and test tokens. However, developer signup requires a mandatory manual application review and approval process by Pinterest before production app credentials and standard access are granted, making fully automated self-serve development impossible.

evidence.quote: Access to Pinterest APIs via User Authorization requires following a flow based on OAuth 2.0.
Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest. You will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed, letting you know whether it was approved or denied access.
One API to seamlessly integrate with Pinterest. Securely plan content, manage ads, upload product feeds, and more.
